name: Marietta Herzog
headline: Building toys for kids' emotional wellness | launching 2025
summary:
I am Marietta, I have a passion for social-emotional learning and mental health.

I am a highly purpose-driven and ambitious person, who loves to work on difficult problems with diverse teams. I bring strong experiences in product management, design, entrepreneurship, and leadership. My background is in Psychology (B.Sc.) and Organizational Psychology (M.Sc.), which helps me to deeply empathize with users as well as my team. I am known for my enthusiasm, which helps me to excite and align people in my team to work towards shared goals and strive for excellence.

Most recently, I led the product development of various employee-facing applications of the B2B SaaS Employee Enablement platform Zavvy. I joined Zavvy as the first employee and supported the notable growth of the company in several critical roles: I co-developed the product vision of the entire platform with the visionary founder team (prev. Freeletics); I owned the design and development of the Minimum viable product (MVP), its launch with first pilot companies and their (100%) conversion into our first paying customers; I led the product development of multiple employee-facing applications (e.g., preboarding, onboarding, training) within the Zavvy platform, as well as complex cross-platform infrastructure (e.g., integrations, notifications, user management, Zavvy AI) with an amazing product team of up to eight engineers and two designers. As of today, Zavvy has raised € 5 M in seed funding and was now exited to Deel.

Before, I interned as UX Designer at Google where I conceptualized, designed and developed an MVP of a mobile app that decreases revenue loss caused by product-inventory downtime by 17%. Beyond expectations, I conducted an entire user study (survey and interviews) to validate the concept and convinced key stakeholders to prioritize implementation.

All in all I have 6+ years of experience in product design and management in a global B2B environment with a strong consumer orientation (i.e., Employees). I am able to lead teams through the uncertainty of product discovery, as well as through a rigorous execution that maximizes user value and strives for excellence.

positions.title: Founding Product Manager
positions.description:
Zavvy is the employee enablement platform that helps growing companies onboard, connect, and develop their employees. Zavvy is funded by 8 investors including Picus Capital Emerge Education and LaFamiglia and was exited to 12$bn HR company deel.

• Identified opportunity, defined product strategy, and led the end-to-end implementation of Zavvy’s MVP with a team of 2 engineers and 1 designer
• Launched pilot leading to 100% conversion
• Led product teams of up to 8 engineers and 2 designers through end-to-end discovery and development of Zavvy’s Preboarding, Onboarding, Event-Scheduling, Engagement, Learning and Training applications
• Cross-application infrastructure (integrations, user management, and notifications) incl. choosing and integrating 3rd party services 
• Cultivated robust alignment with product, marketing, sales, and customer success enabling seamless launches and a 30% reduction in onboarding time
• Owned definition, tracking and reporting of KPIs, and a built a customer feedback database to drive data-informed prioritization with management
• Pioneered self-serve sign-up and free trial with a gamified welcome experience of interactive tours, videos, and chat interactions using third party services leading to additional leads with a conversion rate of up to 15%
